name: Seoul Open Data Plaza realtime air quality by district
short: Seoul's hourly air quality by district (PM10, PM2.5, ozone, NO2, CO, SO2) as JSON. Free key; sample key gives 5 rows.
summary: Seoul Metropolitan Government's Open Data Plaza serves the RealtimeCityAir service: one row per monitoring district (25 rows on 2026-11-06) with PM10, PM2.5, ozone, nitrogen dioxide, carbon monoxide, sulphur dioxide, a 5-level air quality grade and index, and the dominant pollutant. A free key from the portal is needed for full use. The portal's shared 'sample' key returned HTTP 200 with data but is limited to 5 rows per call. Field names are Korean-style codes; the grade text is in Korean.

tasks: latest PM10 and PM2.5 per Seoul district
ozone, NO2, CO and SO2 readings
air quality index and grade by district

coverage.notes: Seoul only, 25 district-level rows on 2026-11-06 (the dataset page says 25 records). For nationwide Korean air quality the AirKorea service was not usable keyless (see research note).

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-06 UTC with the sample key: MSRMT_DT 202611070500 (KST, 05:00 on 7 Nov) on 5 rows requested, list_total_count 25. Dataset page: refresh 'real time', data updated 2026.11.06.

latency.notes: Dataset page says time range is real time in hourly units and update cycle 'real time'; measurement timestamp is on the hour.

freshness.notes: MSRMT_DT gives the measurement hour in KST.

licensing.summary: Dataset page lists the usage scope as Korea Open Government License (KOGL) Type 1: attribution required, commercial use and modification allowed. Copyright holder is Seoul Metropolitan Government, no third-party copyright. Portal terms of use were not read in full. Sample-key calls are rate-limited by the portal; the full key terms were not read.

time.unknown: Timezone is not stated in the response; KST assumed from local time.

location.method: District and station names in the rows (SAREA_NM, MSRSTN_NM).
location.unknown: No coordinates in the response read.

content.method: Official municipal monitoring values; units not stated in the response.
content.unknown: Units and QA are described on the portal's long description, not read here.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments and official forecasts, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

auth.how_to_get: Register on data.seoul.go.kr and request an Open API key; the portal's 'sample' key works for tests with limits.

endpoints.params: key, start and end row index
endpoints.notes: Also xml. With key 'sample' at most 5 rows per call (ERROR-335 otherwise).

api.rate_limits: Not read for full keys; sample key limited to 5 rows per call.
api.notes: HTTP only on this host as tested.
